LanguageData.LP_GenieCore.label: genie origin
LanguageData.LP_GenieCore.description: The body of a genie bound by a lamp. The genie remembers its lamp: a day after the lamp leaves your hands (sold, stolen, destroyed), the genie vanishes in smoke. A genie doesn't die when it falls and leaves no corpse; it turns into blue smoke and returns to the lamp, and after the lamp is dim for 15 days the same genie can be rubbed out again (name, skills and bloodline unchanged, injuries cleared). Genies can't be recruited or captured; elemental bloodline ability cooldowns are halved. Wears a golden circlet on the head.
LanguageData.LP_GenieCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Lamp binding: the genie leaves if the lamp is out of your hands for a full day.
LanguageData.LP_GenieCore.customEffectDescriptions.1: Downed returns to the lamp: doesn't die, leaves no corpse, the lamp is dim for 15 days.
LanguageData.LP_GenieStature.label: genie build
LanguageData.LP_GenieStature.description: The genie's tall figure: actual body size ×150%, drawn ×130%. Giant-body rules give the genie health ×125% and melee ×115%; giant stomach: max food ×150%.
LanguageData.LP_GenieAgeless.label: genie agelessness
LanguageData.LP_GenieAgeless.description: Genies have lived for thousands of years and their bodies no longer age: biological age stops after 18. Genies still need to eat and sleep.
LanguageData.LP_GenieWish.label: make a wish
LanguageData.LP_GenieWish.description: Genies can grant wishes: once every 60 days, pick one of six wishes: harvest, peace, healing, wealth, clear sky, epiphany. After a wish the genie is weary for 15 days.
